interface.longDescription: A complete CTO relationship-intelligence operating system for high-value conversations with founders, CEOs, CTOs, executives, investors, business owners and strategic partners. Performs deep person and company research, recent-activity intelligence, evidence-versus-inference analysis, relationship-stage classification, collaboration mapping, technology-footprint investigation, exactly two evidence-backed Technology Plays with active disconfirmation research, executive conversation strategy, full meeting-pack generation, Parakeet AI live-meeting instructions with trigger logic and warnings, prior-conversation analysis, post-meeting analysis, and ongoing research refreshes. It is designed to build credibility, curiosity, trust and genuine strategic relationships rather than run conventional sales calls.
